title: Why Bluetooth Audio Cuts Out When You Walk Around Cities
topic: Bluetooth shares the crowded 2.4 GHz band with Wi-Fi and more; in dense areas interference plus physical obstacles (a body between phone and earbud) can cause dropouts.
hook: Your earbuds work at home. Walk downtown and they stutter.
twist: The same 2.4 GHz band is shared by Bluetooth and Wi-Fi, and a city is packed with both.
pinnedComment: Earbuds that cut out outside: do you blame the earbuds or the city? 👇
commentPrompt: Phone in front pocket or back pocket: which cuts out more for you?
loop: So... is it the earbuds, or the city?

sources.label: Cult of Mac - AirPods might not like busy city streets
Access Partnership - Bluetooth interference: causes and solutions

weaknesses: Body blocking is general physics (2.4 GHz is absorbed by water) but no source tested it: frame as 'can', and verify against Bluetooth SIG docs on script day. Avoid unsourced percentages.
